time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels and seconds only; no metric scale assumed
summary: Side view across a river. A dark navy motorboat with a white bimini canopy, a German flag on the stern, and 1-2 people aboard crosses from left to right at high speed, leaving a long white wake. The camera pans slowly to the right (background drifts up to ~59 px left). Far bank: dark trees (left), grassy hill (right), a light-coloured riverside path line, a lone tree at the waterline. A small dark figure walks/cycles along the far-bank path at the right in frames 0-58.

camera.columns: bg_dx, bg_dy = image position of a static background point in frame i minus its position in frame 0 (px); scale_vs_f0 and rot_deg_vs_f0 from a similarity fit
camera.pan_description: background moves left (camera pans right, following the boat) from ~f5 to ~f135 (max -58.6 px at ~f135), then drifts back right ~6 px to the end; vertical drift up to +11 px around f115-125. Zoom: scale change < 0.16 % (negligible); rotation < 0.22 deg.
camera.to_background_coords: x_bg = x - bg_dx, y_bg = y - bg_dy (frame-0 background coordinates); boat.csv already has *_bg columns
camera.perspective: 2D scene: boat moves roughly parallel to the image plane along the far half of the river; horizon not visible; far shoreline (water/bank boundary) is a near-horizontal line at y~467 (frame 0). Boat apparent canopy width is constant (~67-68 px), so its distance from the camera is ~constant; the hull's apparent length shrinks (227 -> 179 px) because the boat's heading/yaw changes (later frames show more of the rear deck), not because of distance.

objects.name: boat
objects.description: motorboat (bowrider), dark navy/black hull, white/grey deck edge, white bimini canopy on a frame, German flag (black-red-gold) on the stern, driver + passenger; only vehicle in the scene
objects.direction: left -> right (+x), along the far half of the river
objects.reference_point: ref_x,ref_y = centre of the bounding box (bow tip .. stern end, canopy top .. hull bottom), i.e. the visible centre; for frames cut by the image edge it is the centre of the visible part (cut_by_edge=1)
objects.other_points: bow_x (bow tip, best for front-to-front measurements), stern_end_x (rearmost point), stern_flag_x (left edge of the stern flag), canopy_tm_x (smooth canopy-position track, best for speeds), canopy_x0/x1

length_along_motion_px.note: bow tip to stern end, horizontal; changes with view angle

objects.length_including_note: stern end = flag left edge up to ~f95 (flag hangs at the transom; true transom ~10 px to the right of the flag edge at f61); later the white rear deck/swim platform edge is visible behind the flag and is the rearmost point
objects.image_speed_px_per_frame_info: not a model, for orientation only: canopy moves ~15.3 px/frame (image) / 15.8 (background-compensated) in f21-50 and ~13.4 / 13.5 in f109-138; it slows down in the image
objects.occlusion: never occluded by other objects; spray/wake hides the lower stern; flag occludes the transom

objects.name: boat_flag
objects.description: German flag on a short staff at the stern of the boat, ~10-12 px wide, ~12-15 px tall
objects.track: boat.csv column stern_flag_x (left edge of the flag)

objects.name: boat_people
objects.description: driver (standing/seated under the canopy, skin-coloured upper body) and a passenger, part of the boat
objects.track: move with the boat (under the canopy, ~canopy_x0+40 .. canopy_x1+10)

objects.name: wake
objects.description: white foam trail behind the boat at y~500-525 (frame coords), stretches from the stern back to the left image edge; stays on the water after the boat passes (full-width white line at y~515-525 in the last frames)
objects.moves: grows with the boat; front end attached to the stern

objects.name: bank_figure
objects.description: small dark figure (probably a pedestrian or cyclist) on the light-coloured far-bank path at the right, ~16-18 px tall, ~10-13 px wide, low contrast against grass
objects.direction: left -> right (+x) along the path, ~2.2 px/frame in background coordinates
objects.track: scene/tracks/bank_figure.csv (detected=0 rows interpolated; lost in f21-25, f40-53; leaves view / becomes undetectable after ~f58)

objects.name: far_shoreline
objects.description: boundary between river and far bank; near-horizontal line

objects.name: bank_path
objects.description: light grey/white riverside path or wall line on the far bank, right half of the image

objects.name: lone_tree
objects.description: single deciduous tree standing at the far waterline in front of the hill, centre of the image

objects.name: forest_and_hill
objects.description: dark forest on the far bank (left half, x 0-1000) and a sunlit grassy hill (right half, x 1000-1920) above the shoreline, y 0-467

objects.name: foreground_vegetation
objects.description: near-bank plants: a leafy bush entering at the right edge (x>1840, y 550-1080, more visible after the pan, f~80+) and thin reed stalks at the bottom edge (y>1010, x~880, 1100, 1650)

objects.name: river_water
objects.description: river surface with ripples and sun glints, y 467-1080

events.event: boat bow enters at the left image edge
events.note: bow tip x~7 at f5 (x=0 at ~f4.5)

events.event: boat stern (flag) enters; boat fully in frame
events.note: stern end x~17 at f20 (0 at ~f19)

events.event: boat bow reaches the right image edge
events.note: bow tip 1890.8 at f139, x=1919 at ~f141

events.event: boat stern leaves the right edge; boat gone
events.note: stern end 1852.5 at f150; flag left edge 1878 at f151
moves continuously left->right for the whole time it is visible; no stops, no reversals, no bounces; slight slowing in image px/frame (see boat entry)
